shared_elements: figures holding objects in outstretched hands
figures facing one another (interaction between figures)
low relief carving of clothed human bodies with visible feet and legs
decorative border/panel of repeated small motifs
justification: Both show low-relief standing human figures in profile with distinctive headgear, holding objects out in their hands and confronting another figure, and both include a field of small repeated motifs (glyph-like blocks in A, a rosette band in B). But A is a single dense, cluttered composition of one or two large figures surrounded by ornate regalia, glyph blocks and crowded filler forms, whereas B is a spare, orderly procession of near-identical figures in a single register with plain drapery and highly regularised, naturalistic proportions — quite different conventions of body rendering and layout.
